test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If the exterior angles obtained on producing the base YZ of a triangle XYZ in both ways are 110° and 115°, then the measure of ∠X is:

options.text: one fourth of a right angle
three fourth of a right angle
one fourth of a straight angle

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of the two exterior angles at the base of a triangle is always equal to 180° + the vertical interior angle.

⇒ Ext ∠Y + Ext ∠Z = 180° + ∠X

⇒ 110° + 115° = 180° + ∠X

⇒ 225° = 180° + ∠X

⇒ ∠X = 225° − 180° = 45°

Since a straight angle is 180°, 45° is exactly one fourth of a straight angle.

**∴ The correct answer is one fourth of a straight angle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Exterior angle at Y = 110°

Exterior angle at Z = 115°

**Formula Used:**

Sum of angles on a straight line = 180°

Sum of all interior angles in a triangle = 180°

 
• 
 
 110° 
 70° 
 115° 
 65° 
 45° X Y Z 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interior ∠Y = 180° − 110° = 70°

⇒ Interior ∠Z = 180° − 115° = 65°

In ΔXYZ, the sum of all interior angles is 180°

⇒ ∠X + ∠Y + ∠Z = 180°

⇒ ∠X + 70° + 65° = 180°

⇒ ∠X + 135° = 180°

⇒ ∠X = 180° − 135° = 45°

We know that a straight angle measures exactly 180°.

⇒ Ratio to straight angle = 45° / 180° = 1/4

Thus, ∠X is one fourth of a straight angle.

**∴ The correct answer is one fourth of a straight angle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Angles in a Triangle

The sum of the three interior angles in any planar triangle is always equal to exactly 180°.

Exterior Angle Theorem

The measure of an exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the measures of its two remote and opposite interior angles.

Straight Angle vs Right Angle

A straight angle forms a perfect straight line and measures 180°. A right angle represents a perpendicular intersection and measures 90°.
